newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 25.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 25.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media & the Internet and Brand-name Products.
PARIS - France's Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE) is in talks to sell its 20-percent stake in Decaux, the leading French urban billboard advertising company, a CGE spokeswoman says.(Reuter)

PARIS - Corinne Bouygues has resigned from her two managerial posts at private French television station TF1, a TF1 spokesman says. She was managing director of TF1 Publicite, which sells advertising space on TF1, and chairman of TF1 Entreprises, the channel's teleshopping, video and music arm. (Reuter)

PARIS - Arabsat, which earlier this week cancelled its contract with French state-owned Canal France International (CFI) after the channel broadcast a pornographic film to Arab viewers by mistake, may rent a channel broadcast only to North Africa. A CFI delegation is to meet Arabsat officials in Riyadh next week. (Liberation)
CHICAGO - Air France set special low-priced midweek winter fares from Chicago, Los Angeles and San Francisco to more than 50 European cities, the company said. (Reuter)

LONDON - Shares in British retailer Kingfisher Plc fall after the company says it will hold talks on the possibility of increasing its stake in French furniture retailer BUT, in which it already owns 26 percent. (Reuter)

LONDON - Britain's Grand Metropolitan and Guinness Plc say their boards have unanimously concluded that a three-way drinks merger plan from France's LVMH Moet Hennessey Mouis Vuitton "would result in a substantial loss of shareholder value for the GMG Brands (the Guinness-GrandMet merger) shareholders other than LVMH". LVMH says the GMG merger plan is an incomplete solution to the companies' "lacklustre" performance. (Reuter)
